agents.name: Borrowing base evidence reviewer
agents.summary: A dated evidence review with changed assumptions, reconciliations and unresolved source gaps.
agents.need: Same-date receivables aging, eligible inventory cost/appraisal, credit agreement, advance rates, caps, reserves, commitment, debt drawings and letters of credit. Include the previous dated review and source versions when available.
agents.trigger: A new aging, inventory appraisal, reserve notice, utilization record or certificate date is supplied.
agents.branch: If the new certificate accompanies a specific proposed funding request and a supplied connected-party limit, review the requested exposure against that limit. Headroom remains a monitoring result, not draw permission.
agents.memory: certificate date, aging/appraisal versions, eligibility definitions, reserves applied, drawn/contingent usage and unresolved overadvance
agents.schedule: On request or at a user-authorized reporting checkpoint. Installing this agent creates no recurring schedule.
agents.acceptance: Source populations and certificate date match; every reserve and usage deduction appears once; negative availability stays an overadvance exception. Report changed evidence and actual recalculation; no external transaction or submission is authorized.
agents.deliverable: A collateral certificate reconciliation and signed revolver availability.

distinctFrom.why: Builds actual collateral-tier schedules and facility availability; the existing general credit memo supplies ratios and recommendations rather than a borrowing certificate identity.

agents.name: Debt service covenant evidence reviewer
agents.summary: A dated evidence review with changed assumptions, reconciliations and unresolved source gaps.
agents.need: Signed cash-coverage and fixed-charge definitions, source cash bridge, taxes/capital/rent details, scheduled debt service and three covenant periods. Include the previous dated review and source versions when available.
agents.trigger: A test-period cash figure, payment schedule or signed covenant definition changes.
agents.branch: If only one test period changes, rebuild that period from its source cash and service components and compare the new minimum headroom with the prior dated result. A proposed waiver never replaces the signed threshold.
agents.memory: agreement version, test dates, numerator/denominator definition, source periods, signed headroom and waiver status
agents.schedule: On request or at a user-authorized reporting checkpoint. Installing this agent creates no recurring schedule.
agents.acceptance: Each test keeps its own numerator and denominator; shared source debt service is tied across tables but ratios and cash definitions are never substituted. Report changed evidence and actual recalculation; no external transaction or submission is authorized.
agents.deliverable: A defined cash coverage pack with period headroom and source exceptions.

distinctFrom.why: Reconciles defined cash tests across periods and fixed charges; excludes generic leverage, equity cures and automatic credit conclusions.

agents.name: Maturity funding evidence reviewer
agents.summary: A dated evidence review with changed assumptions, reconciliations and unresolved source gaps.
agents.need: Actual maturities, accessible opening cash, after-operation cash, confirmed refinancing, connected credit exposures and dated owner-approved monitoring limits. Include the previous dated review and source versions when available.
agents.trigger: A contractual maturity, confirmed refinancing notice or accessible cash source changes.
agents.branch: If confirmed refinancing changes revolving interest or commitment fees, compute the actual period charge from verified average balances and terms. Feed only supported cash costs into the affected future cash bucket.
agents.memory: facility IDs, maturity dates, confirmed funding sources, limit version, bucket balances and unresolved financing costs
agents.schedule: On request or at a user-authorized reporting checkpoint. Installing this agent creates no recurring schedule.
agents.acceptance: Only confirmed proceeds fund maturities; unused exposure limit is not cash or loan approval; funding and monitoring limits remain separate. Report changed evidence and actual recalculation; no external transaction or submission is authorized.
agents.deliverable: A maturity funding ladder and connected exposure exception pack.

distinctFrom.why: Reconciles already committed maturity funding and lender exposure capacity without proposing haircut, refinancing certainty or legal restructuring terms.

agents.name: Project debt cash evidence reviewer
agents.summary: A dated evidence review with changed assumptions, reconciliations and unresolved source gaps.
agents.need: Three annual project operating cash records or approved scenarios, financing CFADS definition, loan opening balance, fixed rate, target service cover and contractual loan-life rate. Identify operating source basis: accrual before working-capital settlement or actual cash receipts/payments, with a compatible working-capital perimeter. Include the prior dated review and source versions when available.
agents.trigger: A project operating cash source, financing definition or annual loan-service assumption changes.
agents.branch: If the changed receipt is an availability payment and the actual contract deduction certificate is supplied, reconcile that certified deduction before revising the affected CFADS period. Otherwise preserve the missing payment evidence. Any changed receipt or cost source must preserve the declared accrual-versus-cash basis; do not deduct working-capital settlement twice.
agents.memory: project ID, cash-definition version, annual source dates, debt balance, repayment series, contract discount basis and coverage gaps
agents.schedule: On request or at a user-authorized reporting checkpoint. Installing this agent creates no recurring schedule.
agents.acceptance: All annual cash is rebuilt from dated sources; principal rollforward ties; cash beyond maturity and financing proceeds are excluded from loan-life cover. Actual receipt/payment sources do not receive a second working-capital deduction; accrual and cash-basis routes are explicitly distinguished. Preserve changed-source evidence; no external transaction is authorized.
agents.deliverable: A linked project cash, debt repayment and loan-life cover schedule.

distinctFrom.why: Links contract-qualified operating cash to an actual repayment rollforward and discounted loan-life coverage; broad credit ratios do not supply these compatible schedules.

agents.name: Project reserve evidence reviewer
agents.summary: A dated evidence review with changed assumptions, reconciliations and unresolved source gaps.
agents.need: Actual project cash after operations, senior and junior service schedule, approved reserve draws, next-service requirement, reserve balance and contract payment priority. Include the previous dated review and source versions when available.
agents.trigger: A reserve requirement, authorized draw, upcoming service or payment-priority source changes.
agents.branch: If a signed debt-service test gate is relevant to a requested distribution review, calculate only that cash covenant using the actual definition and periods. A cash residual does not satisfy an unverified distribution gate.
agents.memory: reserve account reference, requirement window, authorized draws, deposits, payment priorities and open service/covenant gates
agents.schedule: On request or at a user-authorized reporting checkpoint. Installing this agent creates no recurring schedule.
agents.acceptance: Reserve top-up appears once; preliminary available funding is reconciled to actual waterfall allocation; every unfilled service or reserve obligation stays visible. Report changed evidence and actual recalculation; no external transaction or submission is authorized.
agents.deliverable: A debt reserve rollforward and payment priority reconciliation.

distinctFrom.why: Combines required reserve movements and operating payment priority with explicit cash ties, beyond general cash positioning.

agents.name: Construction funding evidence reviewer
agents.summary: A dated evidence review with changed assumptions, reconciliations and unresolved source gaps.
agents.need: Certified annual costs and approved draw timing, usable equity/debt commitments, fixed construction interest terms, spent costs and current completion estimate/contingency. Include the previous dated review and source versions when available.
agents.trigger: A certified cost, actual debt draw date, completion estimate or usable commitment changes.
agents.branch: If actual draw timing differs from the prior assumption, recalculate capitalized interest with the evidenced timing fraction and test final debt against remaining commitment. Preserve uncovered interest as a funding gap.
agents.memory: project ID, certified cost version, draw timing, capitalization terms, commitments remaining and completion funding gap
agents.schedule: On request or at a user-authorized reporting checkpoint. Installing this agent creates no recurring schedule.
agents.acceptance: Cost draws exclude separately capitalized interest; interest is checked against commitment capacity; no uncovered interest or cost is silently financed. Report changed evidence and actual recalculation; no external transaction or submission is authorized.
agents.deliverable: A construction funding, capitalized interest and completion gap schedule.

distinctFrom.why: Combines committed cash draws, timed capitalized interest and remaining cost funding; earned-value progress alone does not establish lender commitment capacity.

agents.name: Production contribution evidence reviewer
agents.summary: A dated evidence review with changed assumptions, reconciliations and unresolved source gaps.
agents.need: Measured batch input/good/scrap quantities and recovery cash for each proposed product, proposed output units, selling prices and verified bottleneck hours. Include the previous dated review and source versions when available.
agents.trigger: A measured yield, scrap recovery, input price or proposed product quantity changes.
agents.branch: If an input invoice price changes, bridge commodity intensity and only the approved customer pass-through assumption before rebuilding product contribution. Preserve the original stock cost vintage and do not infer demand or production feasibility.
agents.memory: product units, batch IDs, measured yield, input price dates, approved pass-through, bottleneck scope and proposal version
agents.schedule: On request or at a user-authorized reporting checkpoint. Installing this agent creates no recurring schedule.
agents.acceptance: Per-good-unit costs and product mix quantities use identical physical units; planned volume is not increased automatically from contribution rankings. Report changed evidence and actual recalculation; no external transaction or submission is authorized.
agents.deliverable: A yield-linked product contribution and capacity comparison.

distinctFrom.why: Links physical yield and scrap recovery to proposed product-mix contribution and a single bottleneck check; standard cost variance alone does not supply this forward source map.

agents.name: Utility restricted cash evidence reviewer
agents.summary: A dated evidence review with changed assumptions, reconciliations and unresolved source gaps.
agents.need: Utility billing/collection records, program bank cash, actual grant restrictions, approved eligible program payments, restricted/unrestricted receipts and source allocation rules. Include the previous dated review and source versions when available.
agents.trigger: A utility collection, approved restricted payment, grant condition or bank cash source changes.
agents.branch: If the utility has an actual signed debt-service cash test due, compare only contract-qualifying cash after restriction mapping with the supplied service schedule. If no applicable loan test exists, mark this branch inapplicable rather than inventing a covenant.
agents.memory: program ID, consumer collection cutoff, award version, eligible-payment evidence, restriction balance, bank reconciliation and relevant loan-test scope
agents.schedule: On request or at a user-authorized reporting checkpoint. Installing this agent creates no recurring schedule.
agents.acceptance: Consumer receipts and grant receipts remain separate source streams; restricted releases require evidence and general cash is not double-counted. Report changed evidence and actual recalculation; no external transaction or submission is authorized.
agents.deliverable: A utility collections, restricted fund and usable cash reconciliation.

distinctFrom.why: Adds the water billing-to-cash chain and bank-accessible cash to restricted award movements; a general grant spending pack does not reconcile utility consumer collections and award cash separately.
